label: Vertical decision tree
description: A conditional decision tree: one root question node on top, elbow connectors fanning down into 2-3 result nodes in a row. Each branch carries a small condition badge on its connector (e.g. "sí" / "no" / "> 100ms") and its result node is tinted by tone (positive=accent, negative=accent-2, neutral=muted). Distinct from flow (linear chain) and fanout (orchestration): this encodes IF/THEN branching. Branch count is a parameter; geometry adapts.
validation: connector stroke-dasharray = real px length computed in builder
